requirements.title: Notifications follow the Industry Core notification data format
requirements.statement: Every notification the application sends shall follow the notification data format of CX-0151 (a header and a use-case content) and validate against its JSON schema.

sources.quote: Notifications MUST be compliant to the following data format:
the JSON schema for this schema is available here

requirements.rationale: Receivers process the header of any notification the same way.
requirements.acceptance: Test: every sent notification validates against the stored notification.schema.json; the JSON schema is handed to the assessment body (CX-0151 1.3).
requirements.appliesFrom: Now (CX-Titan) and in CX-Neptune; the normative text is the same in both releases.

requirements.title: Notification operations answer with 200, 4xx or 5xx
requirements.statement: The notification endpoints of the application should answer with 200 when a notification is accepted and with a 4xx or 5xx code when it cannot be processed.

sources.quote: response codes SHOULD be defined for all notification operations:
| 200 | OK | Indicates that the request has succeeded. |
| 4xx | ERROR | The notification cannot be processed. |

requirements.rationale: The sender learns whether its notification was processed; the codes become mandatory once the connector passes backend errors through.
requirements.acceptance: Test: an accepted notification returns 200; a malformed one returns a 4xx code.
requirements.appliesFrom: Now (CX-Titan) and in CX-Neptune; the normative text is the same in both releases.

requirements.title: Digital twin for each serialized part instance and batch to be traced
requirements.statement: The application shall create a digital twin for each serialized part instance, just-in-sequence part instance, vehicle and batch that is to be traced.

sources.locator: 2.1.4 Digital twins and specific asset IDs
sources.quote: A digital twin is required for each single instance of a

sources.locator: 2.1.4 Digital twins and specific asset IDs
sources.quote: just-in-sequence-part or vehicle and each batch to be traced.

requirements.rationale: CX-0127 (Industry Core: Part Instance) 2.0.2 section 2.1.4 requires one digital twin per traced physical instance. A cell or module that the after-first-passport work traces through repair, repurposing or remanufacturing needs its own instance twin, because the as-built bill of material of the battery pack references the cell and module instance twins.
requirements.acceptance: Inspection: every serialized cell, module and battery pack and every batch that the application traces has its own digital twin registered in the digital twin registry of the data provider.
requirements.notes: CX-0127 2.0.2 (CX-Titan) and CX-0127 3.0.0 (CX-Neptune) state no rule for a second twin of the same physical battery after remanufacturing or repurposing (step 2 citation catalogue, section 3 point 4), which the CX-0160 amendment proposal of step 5 of the after-first-passport work addresses. Decision Q-969 (whether a new passport keeps the battery's unique identifier) gives the battery a new unique identifier at a new passport.

neptuneSources.locator: 2.1.4 Digital twins and specific asset IDs
neptuneSources.quote: A digital twin is required for each single instance of a serialized part, just-in-sequence-part or vehicle and each batch to be traced.

requirements.title: As-built bill of material may reference a child's part type twin
requirements.statement: When no part instance digital twin of a child item exists, the application may reference the part type digital twin of the child item in SingleLevelBomAsBuilt.

sources.quote: it is in a second priority possible to reference the part type twin of the child item instead.

requirements.rationale: CX-0127 (Industry Core: Part Instance) 2.0.2 section 3.4.1 makes the part instance twin of a child item the first reference of SingleLevelBomAsBuilt and the part type twin the second. A battery pack whose cells carry no instance twin can then still name the cell type, which keeps the cell chemistry traceable for repair, remanufacturing and recycling.
requirements.acceptance: Inspection: a SingleLevelBomAsBuilt submodel of a battery pack references the part instance twin of each cell that has one, and the part type twin only of a cell that has no part instance twin.
requirements.notes: StR-CXD-058 (part instance bill of material only as SingleLevelBomAsBuilt) names the aspect model, and StR-CXD-964 states the order of the references inside the model.

neptuneSources.quote: However, when no part instance digital twin of the child item exists to reference, it is in a second priority possible to reference the part type twin of the child item instead.

requirements.title: As-built usage never references a parent's part type twin
requirements.statement: When no part instance digital twin of a parent item exists, the application shall not reference the part type digital twin of the parent item in SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt.

sources.quote: even if it would be possible to reference a part type twin of the parent part instead, no reference will be made.

requirements.rationale: CX-0127 (Industry Core: Part Instance) 2.0.2 section 3.5.1 lets SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt reference a parent item only by its part instance twin. A cell or module therefore reaches the battery pack it was built into only through the pack's instance twin, which the after-first-passport work needs to find the passport of the pack from a cell.
requirements.acceptance: Inspection: no SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt submodel of a cell or module references a part type twin.
requirements.notes: StR-CXD-059 (part instance usage only as SingleLevelUsageAsBuilt) names the aspect model, and StR-CXD-965 states the rule on the parent reference inside the model.

neptuneSources.quote: In that case, in contrast to SingleLevelBomAsBuilt, even if it would be possible to reference a part type twin of the parent part instead, no reference will be made.
